name: Nike
look: Monochrome chrome, massive uppercase display burned into full-bleed photography, pill CTAs, zero-radius product cards.

features.title: ENGINEERED TO RETURN
features.sub: Four years of prototypes, twelve thousand kilometres of testing, one plate.

items.title: CARBON PLATE
items.body: A full-length spoon-shaped plate that stiffens the toe-off and cuts the energy lost to ankle flex.

items.title: 178 GRAMS
items.body: A supercritical foam midsole poured at a density we could not reach two seasons ago.

items.title: WIDER BASE
items.body: A broader forefoot platform that holds the line through the last five kilometres.

items.title: ENGINEERED MESH
items.body: A single-layer upper with zoned venting and no overlays to hold water.

items.title: 20% RECYCLED
items.body: By weight, across the upper, the sockliner and the packaging.

items.title: 400KM RATED
items.body: Foam that holds its rebound to four hundred kilometres, verified on the treadmill rig.

showcases.title: STIFFER WHERE IT COUNTS
showcases.body: A spoon-shaped carbon plate runs the full length of the shoe, stiff through the forefoot and compliant at the heel, so the toe-off returns energy instead of absorbing it.

showcases.title: POURED, NOT MOULDED
showcases.body: A supercritical process foams the midsole under pressure, producing a finer, more uniform cell structure that rebounds harder and holds its shape for longer.
points: 87% energy return at the lab bench

items.a: True to size for most runners, with a slightly wider forefoot than the previous generation. If you sized up half a size in the 03, order your true size in the 04.

items.q: Can I return them after running in them?
items.a: Yes. Sixty days, worn or unworn, no questions. Take them out on a real run — that is the only way to know.

items.q: How long does the foam last?
items.a: Rated to four hundred kilometres of rebound on the lab rig. Most runners report the shoe feels flat somewhere between 350 and 500km depending on surface and weight.
Yes. Stack height and plate count are within World Athletics limits for road racing, and the model is on the approved list.

footer.tagline: Sport is not a category. It is the whole point.

notes: Display type is uppercase at line-height 0.9 and burned directly into full-bleed photography. The photograph is the layout.
The palette is pure black, white and one soft grey across roughly 95% of the chrome. Colour arrives only through the imagery.
Every CTA, search field, filter chip and badge is a pill. There are no sharp-cornered interactive elements in the system.
Product cards have zero radius and zero shadow — they sit directly on a soft-grey swatch, because the photograph is the card.
Two-tone CTA hierarchy: black on light, soft-grey on bright. Never both on the same surface.
